notes.title: Patch notes
notes.notes:
The development team will now shift its focus back to the full release version of the game. Updates for the Demo will be less frequent moving forward. If you're interested in the full version, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!


【Update Notice】

Fully exit and close the game client.

Update Method 1​: After closing the game, restart your game platform client. The platform will automatically detect and start downloading the update.

Update Method 2​: Alternatively: Find “Escape from Duckov Demo” in your game library and manually click the "Update" button.



【Update Content】

Updates

●Adjusted the model for the Storm Creature's loot box.

●Mouse side buttons can now be bound in key settings.

●Added scroll wheel behavior options in key settings (Switch Weapon / Switch Interaction).

●Added alternative keybinds for switching weapons and interactions.

●Walking Mushroom bullet speed increased by 50%, range increased by 20%, and slightly faster firing rate.

●Enemy AI improved: After being hit by the player, vision range increases for 1 second.

●During storms, a Storm Creature will appear in the cave.

●Increased range for SKS (26 → 30) and M1A (27.5 → 33), faster aim-down-sight speed (0.6 → 0.5 and 0.8 → 0.6), reduced aiming spread, and improved SKS reload speed (0.5 → 0.35).

●Reduced spread and recoil for Fire AK-47.

●Increased recoil for all shotguns.

●Recovery Injections can no longer stack.

●Storm Protection Injection now removes the “Disturbance” debuff (Weak Spatial Storm).

●Added “Other” tab in the Warehouse.

Fixes:

●Fixed the bug where enemies wouldn't detect players at close range (again).

●Fixed critical rate not showing on some melee weapons.

●Removed ununlockable blueprints from the Recipe Handbook.

●Fixed several sound bugs.

【Update Content】
Updates
●Added new weapon and blueprint: MP-155 ULTIMA.
●You can now change difficulty and talents at the Base.
●Muddy now sells Recovery Injections, which continuously restore HP for 30 seconds after use.
●Electric MP7 damage increased (7.5 → 8.5).
●Rapid Lordon damage reduced by 10%.
●Wrench and Car Wrench are now melee weapons.
●Sledgehammer damage increased (30 → 36).
●Aiming speed improved for VPO (1 → 0.8) and Mosin-Nagant (0.95 → 0.75).
●Added something fun during rainy weather (watch out).
●New food item: Mushroom.
●Added item lock feature in the backpack (hotkey: L) for easier sorting and quick deposit.
●Pet Backpack UI position adjusted.
●M1A can now equip magazines.
Fixes:
●Removed demo-only blueprints from the Recipe Handbook and added unlockable ones.
●Fixed a bug caused by splitting items while performing other actions.
●Fixed AI not detecting enemies in close range.
●Attachments: Laser - Basic and Laser - Calibrated now properly reflect their effects in the stats panel.
●Fixed display issues in non-Simplified Chinese for some new tasks and items.

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.notes:
【Update Notice】
Fully exit and close the game client.
Update Method 1​: After closing the game, restart your game platform client. The platform will automatically detect and start downloading the update.
Update Method 2​: Alternatively: Find “Escape from Duckov Demo” in your game library and manually click the "Update" button.

【Update Content】
Updates
● Implemented the [Unstuck] feature (can be used for cheating in some cases; abusing it may reduce the overall gameplay experience).
● Shovel, hammer, sledgehammer, crowbar, and golf club are now classified as melee weapons.
● Melee weapons now feature headshot and bleeding attributes.
● Added an early backpack upgrade (+5 slots).
● Added a “Store All to Warehouse” button to the backpack.
● Removed the damage penalty for high-penetration rounds (damage coefficient unified to 1).
● Reduced damage taken in the lowest difficulty (from 60% to 50%).
● Kills from bleeding now count toward objectives.
● Fog of war removed in the lowest difficulty.
● Reduced Dwarf Duck’s vision range and attack range by 10%. Also reduced the movement penalty when it is outside vision range.
● Camera no longer zooms while looting.
● Improved the shooting sound effects of Storm Creatures.
● Added additional enemy spawn points near the bunker in the Zero Area.
● Added a disassemble shortcut key (F).
● Added sound effects when completing objectives.
● Gun-related missions now automatically remove attachments upon submission.
Fixes
● Fixed an issue where headshots on Da Xingxing might miss.
● Fixed abnormal spread reduction behavior when aiming with certain guns.
● Fixed an issue where progress was not saved when exiting during evacuation.
● Fixed inconsistent results when organizing the backpack.
● Fixed duplication issue with Tail No.1 and No.3.
● Fixed the icon for L-type bullets.

notes.title: Loot, Shoot, Scoot! Dive into the Trial Version Now!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!
I'm Ducky, and Jeff is working hard on building Ducktopia! 🦆 Come join us in this quacky adventure and help us make history!

🎁 Snack & Soda Station is ready!​​
Ducky-themed goodies are waiting for you! Hurry up, fellow ducklings – don't miss out!

​📅 Demo Schedule​​
​​Opens:​​ May 28, 2025 at 9:00 PM (UTC-7)
​​Closes:​​ July 1, 2025 at 3:00 AM (UTC-7)

Since our last test, we've made the following updates:
✨ Core System Upgrades
Dynamic Environment: Introduced day-night cycles and real-time weather. Nighttime limits visibility and spawns exclusive monsters.
Combat Enhancements: Added dedicated slots for melee weapons (permanently held), active headshot mechanics, and recoil simulation for firearms.
Navigation Optimization: Implemented sound direction indicators, seamless map transitions, and a beacon teleportation system (reduced construction resource requirements).
Economic System: Introduced cash trading and map merchants, along with an equipment dismantling feature (one-click dismantle at the workbench).
🎯 Content Expansion
New Player Friendly: Added a prologue tutorial stage and enhanced early-game quest guidance.
Armory Upgrade: Introduced over 20 new firearms and redesigned all weapon models and icons.
Attachment Diversification: Expanded the attachment pool, offering branches focusing on attack, stability, and stealth attributes.

🎮 Demo Version Alert!​​
This is our early demo build. If you enjoy it, please ​​add our game to your wishlist​​ – your support means everything to us!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342384/a05a6108d977fa99baee33663564844d3b3e78fc.png

We plan to officially launch the game in the second half of 2025. After this test ends, we’ll gather your feedback to refine and optimize the game, and we’ll also work on new maps, items, and storylines. We can’t wait to meet you again with an even better version!

Bug reports and suggestions are always welcome! You can email us at duckov@bilibili.com, and we’ll address your issues as soon as possible.
You can also join our Discord to connect with other players and share your thoughts.
 https://discord.gg/BAgYfrSBaS

Bestwishes~!
